title: What requirements apply to buyer-made hearth plates for a wire-coil bogie-hearth furnace?
summary: Buyer-made hearth plates are more than steel plates that carry weight. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s metal wire-coil bogie-hearth proposal dated 2 November 2021 assigns heat-resistant steel hearth plates to the buyer. They must support loads, distribute heat into the furnace and reduce scale falling into bottom elements. The main procurement task is to coordinate these plates with Suneng's proposed bogie, heaters and loading arrangement.
